video_title: Update on Steph Curry & Luka Doncic's recovery timelines 🚨 | SportsCenter

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' system allows them to compete without Stephen Curry
quotes.excerpt: they've had a group and a system that has allowed them to play well without Steph
quotes.quote: It's a tough blow, but they've been playing really good basketball. Luckily for them, they've had a group and a system that has allowed them to play well without Steph this year. Unfortunately, last year it was a struggle for them. Luckily for them, this is an oblique situation, he can come back full health in a couple of weeks, hopefully in that three-week period. It does affect everything that you do. They do have a favorable schedule the next two weeks. It may take a little longer for him to come back than two weeks, but this is something that's going to nag him, but at the end of the day, he'll be back and be Steph Curry when he's healthy.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry expected to miss about a month with oblique tear
quotes.excerpt: Warriors are expecting Stephen Curry to be sidelined for about a month with this oblique abdominal tear
quotes.quote: I'm told that the Warriors are expecting Stephen Curry to be sidelined for about a month with this oblique abdominal tear, and they're going to re-evaluate him officially in about 14 days. At that point, they're going to get a better feel for what his recovery looks like, what the rehab looks like. Could it be three weeks? Could it be four weeks? Could it be a little bit more than that? That's what they're going to know in about 14 days, but they're bracing for him to be out at least a double-digit sum of games.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic avoiding serious injury after turning his ankle
quotes.excerpt: he woke up with no pain today in that ankle, that he's doing good
quotes.quote: Good news for Luka Doncic. I'm told by one source that he woke up with no pain today in that ankle, that he's doing good, and the plan is for Luka Doncic to go through his normal treatment process in the lead up to Sunday's game in Phoenix. We know Luka Doncic has been on an MVP-caliber run this year. It looks like he's avoided anything serious.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves undergoing testing on heel injury
quotes.excerpt: JJ Redick has said that he's going to undergo testing today on that heel injury
quotes.quote: Austin Reaves on the other hand, JJ Redick has said that he's going to undergo testing today on that heel injury that he suffered, but I'm told as of now, no MRI has been taken or is planned for today. It remains to be seen whether he's going to have one either tomorrow or on Saturday in the lead up to Sunday's game, so certainly could be a sign that he's avoided anything major.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Caleb Wilson to miss 4-6 weeks following hand surgery
quotes.excerpt: it is a fractured right hand, he's undergoing surgery, he's going to miss four to six weeks
quotes.quote: In Chicago with Caleb Wilson, their prized rookie, I'm told it is a fractured right hand, he's undergoing surgery, he's going to miss four to six weeks for the Bulls. This is his shooting hand, but certainly a setback for Caleb Wilson and the team, as he's been the young face of this rebuild that the Bulls are on. He'd been averaging 19 points and six rebounds in his first 10 games.
